meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning: a hostile team cross-critiques a plan before it is formalized. Use when planning needs maximum rigor or the user asks for a hyperplan / adversarial or cross-critique plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让关键计划在敲定前先经受多方挑刺与交叉质疑,变得更扎实
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你制定关键计划时希望有人从对立角度帮你查漏补缺,而不是只收获附和。
copy.tagline_en: Toughen up your plan by running it past a hostile review team before you commit.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you own important plans and want them to survive hostile scrutiny before being locked in.

howto.what: Claude 会组建一支 5 人虚拟对抗团队,成员互相攻击、挑出计划漏洞,只留下经得住批评的要点,再交给专门的规划者写成正式计划。启动时会先宣布“HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!”。
howto.when: 当你明确要求做 hyperplan、对抗性或交叉评审式计划,或说规划必须极其严谨时触发;平时普通规划不会自动启用。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 模式规划这次的数据库迁移。
say.note: Claude 将召集 5 人对抗团队互批方案。

say.text: 对抗性评审一下这个发布计划,尽量挑刺。
say.note: 成员会攻击漏洞,只留经得住批评的要点。

say.text: 帮我把重构方案做成 cross-critique 计划。
say.note: 适合需要极高严谨度的规划。

howto.what_en: Claude runs a 5-member adversarial team that cross-critiques the plan; surviving insights go to a dedicated planner for formalization. It announces 'HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!' on launch.
howto.when_en: Use when the user asks for a hyperplan, an adversarial/cross-critique plan, or when planning needs maximum rigor.

say_en.text: Make a hyperplan for this database migration.
say_en.note: Claude assembles a 5-member adversarial team to critique it.

say_en.text: Adversarially review this release plan and find every flaw.
say_en.note: Only defensible insights survive into the final plan.

say_en.text: Turn this refactor into a cross-critique plan.
say_en.note: Use when planning must be maximally rigorous.
